CODE OF ORDINANCES City of HOUSTON, TEXAS Codified through Ordinance No. 2026-0732, adopted August 19, 2026. (Supp. No. 93, Update 2)

 VIEW WHAT'S CHANGED

This Code of Ordinances and/or any other documents that appear on this site may not reflect the most current legislation adopted by the Municipality.

Adopted Ordinances Not Yet Codified

The listing below includes all legislation received by Municipal Code since the last update (printed or electronic) to the Code of Ordinances. This legislation has been enacted, but has not yet been codified.

Ordinance No. 2026-0825

Adopted 9/23/26

AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 18-104 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES, HOUSTON, TEXAS, RELATING TO THE FAILURE TO TIMELY FILE A CAMPAIGN FINANCE REPORT; CONTAINING FINDINGS AND OTHER PROVISIONS RELATING TO THE FOREGOING SUBJECT; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; AND DECLARING AN EMERGENCY.

Ordinance No. 2026-0803

Adopted 9/23/26

AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTERS 16 AND 26 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE CITY OF HOUSTON, TEXAS, RELATING TO ON-STREET PARKING REGULATIONS, INCLUDING SERVICE OF PARKING CITATIONS BY MAIL; DECLARING CERTAIN CONDUCT TO BE UNLAWFUL AND PROVIDING A PENALTY THEREFOR; CONTAINING FINDINGS AND OTHER PROVISIONS RELATING TO THE FOREGOING SUBJECT; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; AND DECLARING AN EMERGENCY.
